comment: One row for each clause of the rules V14, V15 and V16 of the FIR verifier
(src/fort/fir_verify.ft, spec/fir.md 10), for each effect of a statement that their one
dataflow reads, for the limits of the three sets of locals, and for the order of the report.
A row names the line that decides the clause. The first stage runs the suite of the verifier
(test/fort/fir_verify_test.ft). The second stage runs the suite that changes one statement
of a lowered function (test/fort/fir_lower_premise_test.ft). The third stage runs the FIR
tests, whose directory test/fir/verify holds a text for each clause. The table runs in the
Linux VM with the debug preset and the default runner. The md5 guard reads the product
compiler. The first round of a run can read stale (notes/testing.md 7), so the first row is
one that a full run caught.
build: sleep 2 && touch src/fort/fir_verify.ft && ninja -C build/Linux/debug fort

stages.name: the suite of the verifier
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 fir_verify_test

stages.name: the premises on lowered functions
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 fir_lower_premise_test
